items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: He said, uh, y'all really plays that stuff. He was a white fellow. See, he talked just like an eagle. And who was it? But Charlie Mack of Swar and Mack.

ctx.x: Yeah. So you were born, you say, 1889. 89. Yeah. So you were about 20, 23 years old.

Yeah, about then, yeah. And, uh, so we were, we were, we were playing on this wagon up in Down Canal Street. Blasting away. It just went about five o'clock, you know. The fight starts at eight. And there's a couple of guys standing around and listening to us. And one said, one come over here. He says, say, buddy. He said, uh, y'all really plays that stuff. He was a white fellow.
